scheme_name: Financial Assistance for the Education of Children of the Beneficiary (O.B.O.C.W.W.B)
other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Odisha.
Applicant must be a Building/Construction Worker.
Applicant must have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.
Applicant must not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law.
Applicant must be a registered member of the Odisha Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
Member must be registered for a period of one year or more under the board.
Children must be studying in class VI and above.
If both spouses are registered beneficiaries, either can apply for the benefit.
benefits_summary: Provides annual cash assistance to children studying class 6 and above, ranging from ₹2,000 to ₹4,000 per year, with one‑time awards of up to ₹10,000 for 10th‑class toppers and ₹40,000 for technical education courses.
